text: The 2009‑to‑today revenue series for Apple under us‑gaap/Revenues has two structural problems that affect its completeness for a long‑run growth model. An early_stop finding shows the series stops at the period ending 2018‑09‑29, with the last reported value of $265,595,000,000 from the 10‑K filed 2018‑11‑05; no revenue is reported under this concept after that date, despite the request extending to 2025‑10‑26. A late_start finding indicates the series only begins on 2015‑09‑27, because Apple adopted this XBRL tag late; earlier fiscal years sit under another revenue concept or predate the tag’s appearance, so the request’s 2009 start falls outside the tagged series. Together these findings mean the series covers only the 2015‑2018 window in the tagged data, leaving pre‑2015 and post‑2018 gaps that must be filled from other filings or concepts before the series can be trusted for a full‑period growth model.
